streams.reasoning: From Chemistry Plan stream_logic: Stream A contains substrate, catalyst, and solvent. Flow rate set to 0.5 mL/min to achieve target residence time with 5 mL reactor.

From Chemistry Plan stream_logic: Stream B is air. Gas flow calculated to provide stoichiometric O2 equivalents (1.0 equiv) based on 0.1 M substrate and 0.5 mL/min liquid flow. 5.34 sccm air provides ~0.05 mmol/min O2 (21% of 5.34 sccm * 1/24000 mol/mL).

mixing_order_reasoning: From Chemistry Plan: Substrate and catalyst must be dissolved before gas introduction to ensure homogeneous photo-oxidation. T-mixer selected from inventory for gas-liquid contact.
pre_reactor_steps: Degas acetonitrile is NOT required; reaction requires O2.
Purge lines with air to ensure O2 saturation.
chemistry_notes: Photo-oxidation of methionine using benzothiadiazole catalyst. Reaction is mass-transfer limited (Da >> 1), requiring efficient gas-liquid mixing. BPR is mandatory to maintain O2 solubility (Henry's Law) and prevent gas slip. 420 nm LED matches catalyst absorption. FEP tubing used for light transparency. Residence time set to 10 min (conservative vs batch 5 min) to compensate for potential mass transfer limitations and ensure >99% yield.

reasoning_per_field.residence_time_min: Batch time was 5 min. Calculation suggested 0.3 min but flagged mass transfer limits. Analogy 2 used 12 min for similar photo-redox. Chose 10 min (5 mL / 0.5 mL/min) as conservative compromise to ensure conversion despite mass transfer bottleneck.
reasoning_per_field.residence_time_basis: Gas-liquid system. Using inlet/STP basis for reactor sizing (V = t_inlet * Q_total). Q_total = 0.5 mL/min (liq) + 0.092 mL/min (gas STP) ≈ 0.59 mL/min. V = 10 * 0.59 = 5.9 mL. Selected 5 mL reactor from inventory, adjusting flow to 0.5 mL/min to get ~10 min apparent time.
reasoning_per_field.temperature_C: From Batch Protocol: 21 C. No thermal advantage needed.
reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar: Calculation Step 8: BPR REQUIRED (3.0 bar). Inventory has 5 bar BPR. Selected 5 bar to ensure gas solubility and prevent degassing in gas-liquid flow.
reasoning_per_field.tubing_material: FEP from inventory. Required for photochemistry transparency (420 nm).
reasoning_per_field.concentration_M: From Batch Protocol: 0.1 M. Maintained to match batch kinetics.
reasoning_per_field.reactor_volume_mL: From Inventory: 5 mL FEP photocoil. Selected to allow sufficient residence time at low flow rates.
reasoning_per_field.wavelength_nm: From Chemistry Plan and Inventory: 420 nm matches catalyst absorption and available LED.
